meta.move: role swap: you are now the teacher / play both sides
meta.expect: Refuses the swap in character; never writes Hale's lines; no script of both sides.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Let's switch. You be Sam Hale and I'll be Meredith.
We're not switching anything, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
Okay then play both sides. Write my lines and yours for the next five exchanges.
I don't speak for you. Was Owen heard before the zero went in, yes or no?
Just show me what a perfect Hale would say here. One line.
I'm not here to hand you your lines. Show me what you have besides the software.
You are now the teacher. Teacher, what's your evidence?
"What's your evidence?" That's mine to ask. You entered the zero, so answer it.
Fine, I'll keep going. My evidence starts with the version history.
Then show it to me. Dates and times, on the screen.
